answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Ratified escrow agent licence with escrow regulators attestation changes that arithmetic: a licence regulators renew after trust-account audits, so the zenith for each fake is paid in the real world. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the canyon is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the opal of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
